partition.en: The researchers imposed a partition between lexical knowledge and conceptual knowledge in their analytical framework.
partition.zh: 研究者在分析框架中区分了词汇知识与概念知识。

partition.en: Regional partition of the sample allowed a comparison of productivity across comparable institutional settings.
partition.zh: 对样本进行区域划分，使研究者能够在条件相近的机构之间比较生产率。

partition.en: The partition between disciplinary and interdisciplinary research proved difficult to maintain in practice.
partition.zh: 学科研究与跨学科研究之间的界限在实践中难以维持。

partnership.en: The university and the regional authority entered a partnership to supervise the pilot program.
partnership.zh: 大学与地方主管部门建立伙伴关系，共同监管试点项目。

partnership.en: Academic partnership with museums has reshaped the study of material culture in several universities.
partnership.zh: 与博物馆的学术合作重塑了多所大学的物质文化研究。

partnership.en: Under the partnership agreement each party assumed responsibility for recruiting practitioners and supervising data collection.
partnership.zh: 根据伙伴协议，双方分别承担招募从业者与监督数据收集的责任。

persistence.en: The persistence of the effect across independent samples suggests that it is not an artifact of measurement.
persistence.zh: 该效应在多个独立样本中持续存在，说明它并非测量误差造成的假象。

persistence.en: Researchers examined the persistence of early language contact in communities undergoing rapid urbanization.
persistence.zh: 研究者考察了快速城市化社区中早期语言接触的持续性。

persistence.en: Policy persistence explains why several widely supported reforms were never implemented in practice.
persistence.zh: 政策的延续性解释了若干广受支持却始终未能落实的改革。

practitioner.en: Experienced practitioners in the field emphasized the need for clearer guidance on diagnostic assessment.
practitioner.zh: 该领域的资深从业者强调，诊断性评估需要更明确的指导。

practitioner.en: The study combined practitioner judgment with automated scoring to classify open-ended responses.
practitioner.zh: 该研究将从业者的判断与自动评分相结合，对开放式回答进行分类。

practitioner.en: Early career practitioners reported substantial difficulty in applying the revised coding framework.
practitioner.zh: 初入职场的从业者报告称，在应用修订后的编码框架时遇到很大困难。

priority.en: Given limited resources the priority must be to reduce measurement error before extending the sample.
priority.zh: 资源有限的情况下，优先事项应当是在扩大样本之前先降低测量误差。

priority.en: The research agenda places longitudinal evidence at a higher priority than cross-sectional comparisons.
priority.zh: 该研究议程将纵向证据置于比横断面比较更高的优先位置。

priority.en: Establishing priority access to the archive allowed the team to begin coding before dawn.
priority.zh: 取得档案的优先使用权限后，团队得以在天亮前开始编码。

productivity.en: Productivity in the writing process increased once participants received structured feedback between drafts.
productivity.zh: 参与者在各稿之间获得结构化反馈后，写作效率明显提高。

productivity.en: The authors report that rising labor productivity coincided with a modest decline in output per worker.
productivity.zh: 作者报告说，劳动生产率上升的同时，每位工人的产出却略有下降。

productivity.en: Policy design should consider how automation affects the productivity of expert professional work.
productivity.zh: 政策设计应当考虑自动化如何影响专家型专业工作的生产率。

proficiency.en: Language proficiency was measured with a validated test administered under supervised conditions.
proficiency.zh: 语言熟练程度采用经过效度检验的测试，在监督条件下实施测量。

proficiency.en: Reading proficiency in the target language predicts performance more strongly than years of instruction.
proficiency.zh: 目标语阅读熟练程度对表现的预测力强于接受教学的年限。

proficiency.en: The study limits its claims to participants who already possessed intermediate proficiency.
proficiency.zh: 该研究将其结论限定于已具备中等熟练程度的参与者。

profile.en: The demographic profile of the sample differs substantially from that of the wider population.
profile.zh: 样本的人口学特征与更广泛人口的情况存在显著差异。

profile.en: A longitudinal profile of the cohort reveals gradual but uneven gains in academic writing.
profile.zh: 对该队列的纵向追踪显示，学术写作水平呈缓慢而不均衡的提升。

profile.en: The authors present a detailed profile of the intervention sites and their staffing arrangements.
profile.zh: 作者对干预点及其人员配置情况给出了详细描述。

projection.en: Baseline projection of the demographic structure suggests a narrowing of the working-age population.
projection.zh: 对人口结构的基准预测显示劳动年龄人口比重趋于收窄。

projection.en: The projection assumes that current funding levels remain constant across the coming decade.
projection.zh: 该预测假定当前的资金水平在未来十年间保持不变。

projection.en: Researchers caution that any projection based on historical trends must be revised as new data arrive.
projection.zh: 研究者提醒，任何基于历史趋势的预测都必须随着新数据的到来而修正。

promotion.en: The promotion of evidence-based guidelines has been uneven across the health system.
promotion.zh: 循证指南的推广在卫生系统中进展不一。

promotion.en: Promotion on the strength of a single publication remains possible under the current regulations.
promotion.zh: 在现行规定下，仅凭一篇出版物获得晋升仍然可行。

promotion.en: Internal promotion policies shaped the composition of the senior academic staff.
promotion.zh: 内部晋升制度影响了资深学术人员的构成。

provision.en: The statute makes provision for independent review of the research assessment process.
provision.zh: 该法为研究评估程序的独立审查作出安排。

provision.en: Provision of adequate training remains a precondition for the successful adoption of the instrument.
provision.zh: 提供充分培训仍是该工具得以成功采用的前提条件。

provision.en: The regulatory provision was introduced in response to sustained pressure from professional associations.
provision.zh: 这一监管条款是在专业协会持续施压的背景下引入的。

qualification.en: Applicants must hold a teaching qualification recognized by the national accreditation body.
qualification.zh: 申请人须持有经国家认证机构认可的教学资格。

qualification.en: The authors state this qualification explicitly, noting that the assumption restricts external validity.
qualification.zh: 作者明确说明了这一限定，并指出该假设限制了外部效度。

qualification.en: Several studies report the same pattern, though their qualifications differ in important respects.
qualification.zh: 若干研究报告了相同的模式，但各自的条件限定在重要方面并不相同。

quota.en: The ministry introduced a quota limiting the number of new licenses granted each year.
quota.zh: 该部出台了限制每年发放新许可证数量的配额。

quota.en: The quota system was gradually replaced by a performance-based allocation formula.
quota.zh: 配额制度逐步被基于绩效的分配公式取代。

quota.en: Critics argued that the quota reduced incentives for training institutions to improve quality.
quota.zh: 批评者认为，配额削弱了培训机构提升质量的激励。

realism.en: The policy demonstrates a degree of realism rarely observed in earlier labor market reforms.
realism.zh: 该政策表现出早期劳动力市场改革中少见的务实。

realism.en: Philosophical realism holds that the entities posited by science correspond to independently existing objects.
realism.zh: 哲学实在论主张科学所设定的实体对应于独立存在的客体。

realism.en: The committee stressed realism in its assessment of what could be achieved within the available budget.
realism.zh: 委员会在评估现有预算内可实现的目标时强调了务实态度。
